files.description: The complete set of generated files. Never a patch or a diff.

path.description: Relative path. Exactly one of: Features/<Flow>.feature, Steps/<Flow>Steps.cs, PageObjects/<PageName>.cs. Never Support/, never a .csproj, never a .locators.json, never contains '..'.

content.description: Complete file content. No markdown code fences. Never truncated, never uses '...' elisions.

locators.description: Every locator the page objects reference. These are serialized into the .locators.json files by the toolkit, not by you.

page.description: Page object class name, e.g. LoginPage.

url.description: The URL this page object navigates to.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what you generated and anything the user should check.
